title: Wear: blank AAPS watchface on Samsung Watch 4
symptom: AAPS watchfaces show totally black on Samsung Watch 4 with latest AAPS version (3.1.0.3-dev-c-AIMI). The wear app itself works (bolus from watch) and complications work on other watch faces, but AAPS watchfaces are black. Reinstalling and rebooting did not help.
cause: The issue is caused by old dependent libraries that need jetifier to work on modern Android, but jetifier was disabled in a commit. The crash is due to NoClassDefFoundError for android/support/v4/widget/ScrollerCompat when inflating the LineChartView.
fix: Enable jetifier again and rebuild, or use a watch face without a chart until fixed. Alternatively, use an older wear build from before the change.
evidence_quote: Issue is caused be depended libraries that are old, to make them work on modern Android, jettifier could be used. However this was disabled in commit https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/e7c41beab74306ee3b5c68c41aac9bf05da36034
